text: This report recommends that the name "Miriam Garfinkle Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane south of Barton Avenue, extending easterly from Clinton Street. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Miriam Garfinkle Lane" for an existing public lane south of Barton Avenue, extending easterly from Clinton Street.
